title: fresh-sim.sh exits silently, with status 1 and no message, when the "HR Demo iPhone" device does not exist yet, so it never makes it
evidence: Closed 2026-11-25 (owner ruling): dev-script; the demo device now exists. ios/scripts/fresh-sim.sh:12 set -euo pipefail; :26 device=$(xcrun simctl list devices available | grep -F ... | head -1 | sed ...): grep finds no device, exits 1, and pipefail ends the script before :27 creates it. Seen 2026-11-11 on PR 1288 (the device made by hand with simctl create)
